checks.text: The page displays the heading "Screen Recorder" and, with no recordings, shows the text "No recordings yet".

Clicking the button "Record screen" starts a recording; after 3 seconds, clicking the button "Stop" adds a list item containing "Screen" and the text "0:03", and the button label changes to "Record screen".
In the list item for the screen recording, clicking the button "Delete" removes that item, and the text "No recordings yet" reappears.
Clicking the tab "Camera" shows a button "Capture frame"; clicking it adds a list item containing "Frame" and the text "0:00".
In the "Library" tab, every list item has a button "Download"; clicking "Download" on the item containing "Screen" triggers a file download with a name ending in ".webm".
Selecting "1080p" in the field labelled "Resolution" and then recording a 2-second screen clip adds a list item containing "1080p" and "0:02".
After adding a screen recording and a camera frame, reloading the page still shows both list items with their original labels and durations.
Clicking the button "Clear all" in the "Library" tab removes all list items and shows the text "No recordings yet".
